description.value: Hamilton Hobby Farm is a 12-acre family-run petting farm tucked into the Coombs Country corridor on Vancouver Island, just across from Butterfly World and minutes from the famous Goats on the Roof Market. Visitors can brush goats, feed chickens, see ponies, and take hayrides across the back forty — making it a lively roadside stop along the Alberni Highway for families and curious cyclists alike. The farm also sells fresh eggs, seasonal produce, homemade jams, and farm-raised poultry directly on site.
